حَيْلَةٌ A large number of goats: (S:) or a herd of goats: and a flock of sheep. (K.) ―
-b2- Stones rolled down from the side of a mountain to its bottom until they become many: (K:) or an overhanging mass of rock that falls down from the head of a mountain to its bottom. (Abu-l-Mekárim, O.) ＝
-A2- See also حَيْلٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
